Are there any flights to London you can put me on?
I'm worried about making it there in time for my daughter's university graduation tomorrow.
Yes, there's a flight to London that boards in 30 minutes.
I'll book that for you now.
Perfect, thanks.
Also, where's the closest place I can buy a newspaper in this airport?
At Beacon Newsstand.
Should I head out of this waiting area and turn right?
No, if you make a left, you'll see it immediately.

在 Beacon Newsstand。
我应该离开等候区向右拐吗？
不，如果你左转，你会马上看到它的。
